purpose: A frontend-agnostic visual profile for recreating a polished, technical, data-workbench interface with consistent layout, color, typography, component, and interaction patterns. This profile intentionally excludes product-specific labels, business data, page copy, and feature content.

styleSummary.visualMetaphor: A command-center workspace for inspecting, generating, validating, and linking structured data objects.
styleSummary.coreLook: Light neutral surfaces, crisp slate borders, indigo primary actions, small mono metadata labels, rounded cards, raised pill buttons, and subtle motion that suggests live system activity.
avoid: dark-first layouts except for isolated code preview blocks
flat controls with no tactile feedback
including domain-specific frontend content or exact page labels

usage.sans: Use for readable body copy, labels, panel titles, card titles, buttons, and form fields.
usage.mono: Use for technical metadata, status labels, counters, column names, data types, compact pills, timestamps, and code.
usage.uppercaseMetadata: Small uppercase mono labels with tracking are a recurring signature. Use them for status, categories, panel subtitles, and system hints.
usage.headings: Keep headings compact and semibold or bold. Avoid oversized marketing headings.

liveIndicators: animated dashed lines for connected graph relationships
skeleton shimmer for pending AI responses

appShell.structure: Full-height workspace with fixed top navigation and a three-column body.
appShell.overflow: hidden at shell level, scroll only within panels and canvas

topNav.content: brand area, centered status capsule, right-aligned action group

centerWorkspace.role: primary tabbed canvas or active work area
centerWorkspace.surface: slate muted background with white inner canvases

rightPanel.role: context inspector, metrics, object details, generated output

collapsiblePanels.behavior: Collapse side panels to zero width with opacity transition; provide slim floating handles to reopen.

canvas.purpose: A large scrollable technical design area for node cards, diagrams, relationships, or spatial objects.
overlays: absolute SVG layer for relationship lines
spatialRules: Use draggable cards with fixed compact widths around 220px.
Use bezier connection lines between related objects.
Put connection lines behind cards and use dashed animation to imply live flow.

tabs.placement: Thin strip above the main center content.
tabs.style: Rounded pill tabs with bold small labels, icons, colored active state, and tactile bottom border.
tabs.activeColorRule: Assign one accent color per major workflow area while preserving indigo as the primary default.

brandLockup.iconTile: Primary indigo rounded square with white icon and small shadow.
brandLockup.title: 18px bold sans, slate near-black.
brandLockup.subtitleOrEditableContext: 12px muted sans, no visible border, hover darkens.

statusCapsule.contents: active dot, mono uppercase label, mono value, semantic badge
statusCapsule.recommendedUse: Summarize live system or object status.

topNavigation.actions: Right-aligned compact pill buttons with icons and tactile bottom border.

base.shape: pill for primary actions, rounded-md for icon-only micro actions

semantic.success: Use emerald background for confirmations or mapping actions.
semantic.info: Use sky/cyan accents for informational objects.
semantic.warning: Use amber for link mode, warnings, or pending compliance.
semantic.danger: Use rose/red only for destructive actions or critical validation.

button.interaction: On hover, raise by 1px and increase bottom border; on active, lower by 2px and reduce bottom border.

base.overflow: auto inside the panel, not on body

base.hover: slight background shift, optional shadow increase

technicalCard.header: mono or uppercase metadata label with accent icon
technicalCard.body: small sans copy with tight leading
technicalCard.footer: thin top border with mono metadata or actions

nodeCard.purpose: Reusable compact object card for graph, schema, workflow, or data-model nodes.

header.text: 12px uppercase, heavy sans, white on colored background
header.rightControls: small disclosure control plus status dot

rows.label: left aligned, truncate
rows.statusPrefix: small PK/FK/state marker in accent color

messageBubble.layout: Narrow stacked cards aligned left for assistant/system and right for user/operator.
messageBubble.metadata: 10px mono uppercase row with icon and timestamp.

input.font: 12px sans or 11px mono for technical fields

dropzone.activeState: indigo border with very soft indigo background

validationOrStatusList.aggregateCards: Three-column semantic cards for success, warning, and error states.

codeBlock.usage: Use dark blocks sparingly for generated code or technical previews.

modal.overlay: slate-900 at 60% opacity with light blur

iconography.style: Thin line icons with consistent stroke, typically 12px to 20px.
iconography.placement: Icons appear before labels in buttons, titles, metadata rows, status chips, and cards.
colorRules: Use primary indigo for system or AI controls.
Use emerald for connected, valid, successful, or mapped states.
Use sky/cyan for secondary object types and inspect/info states.
Use amber for warning, pending, or active linking states.
Use rose/red for destructive actions and failed checks.
motionRules: Spin only processing or orbiting states.
Avoid animating every icon; reserve motion for state meaning.

interactionModel.tactileControls: Buttons feel pressable through bottom-border depth, small hover lift, and active downward translation.
interactionModel.selection: Selected graph objects receive an accent border plus a low-opacity ring. Avoid changing the whole card background.
interactionModel.hover: Hover states are subtle: slightly brighter surface, stronger shadow, darker text, or 1px upward movement.
interactionModel.focus: Inputs and key actions use indigo border or ring.
interactionModel.loading: Use compact skeleton rows, pulsing dots, spinning icons, or temporary disabled states.
interactionModel.progressiveDisclosure: Complex cards should support expanded/collapsed modes. Collapsed mode shows a compact count or summary.
interactionModel.dragging: Canvas objects can be dragged. Cursor switches to grab/grabbing and positions snap to a 10px grid.
interactionModel.relationshipCreation: Use a temporary warning/amber mode for link creation, then render persistent animated indigo connection paths.

compositionRules.density: Keep interfaces compact enough for expert workflows while preserving white space between panels and groups.
surfaceHierarchy: Primary active objects: accent-colored headers or badges
compositionRules.borders: Use borders more often than heavy shadows. Shadows should clarify layering, not decorate.
compositionRules.accentUse: Indigo is the default action and system color. Semantic accents should be localized to object type or state.
compositionRules.metadataLanguage: Use small uppercase mono labels for technical context, statuses, counts, and categories.
compositionRules.contentAgnosticism: When replicating the design, substitute generic object names and workflows. Preserve layout, rhythm, states, and visual grammar, not the original frontend's domain copy.
compositionRules.responsiveness: For narrow screens, collapse side panels first, keep top actions compact, and let the center workspace remain scrollable.
accessibility: Maintain high contrast for text on accent backgrounds.
Do not rely on color alone; pair semantic colors with icons, badges, or labels.
Keep interactive targets at least 32px tall where possible.
Use focus outlines or rings for keyboard-accessible controls.

aiReplicationPrompt.instruction: Use this profile to generate a light technical data-workspace UI. Recreate the visual grammar: white/slate panels, indigo primary controls, compact mono metadata, tactile pill buttons, card-based inspectors, graph/canvas affordances, semantic status colors, and subtle live motion. Do not reuse any product-specific names, labels, datasets, table names, business copy, or exact frontend content from the source project.
mustInclude: large scrollable canvas or work area
subtle animations for live, loading, and relationship states
mustAvoid: copying original frontend text or domain entities
making the design feel like a generic SaaS landing page
flattening all controls into borderless buttons
